user.title: Set up EnergyIQ
user.description: Select the whole-home power source and, if desired, restore existing EnergyIQ data.

init.title: EnergyIQ settings
init.description: Select monitored devices, then configure four daily color-threshold points for Peak and Off-Peak consumption.

consumption_thresholds.title: Consumption color thresholds
consumption_thresholds.description: Set four time-of-day points for Peak and Off-Peak. Each point has a yellow-above and red-above limit in kWh for that hour. Thresholds between points are interpolated. Each elapsed hour is one solid color; there are no gradients.

error.times_must_increase: Times must be in increasing order.
error.red_must_be_at_least_yellow: Red threshold must be at least the yellow threshold.
